personnelRefresh.summary: App State's official Oct. 21 game-day preview says QB Malachi Singleton is listed questionable on the initial Sun Belt availability report. He was a game-time decision the prior week, started and went 12-of-14 for 151 yards in the first half, while Henry Hasselbeck played the entire second half and rushed for 125 yards. James Madison's established Camden Coleman/JC Evans two-QB usage remains intact. No official source captured here confirms Singleton out or announces a new starter.
